svg.aria-label: All panels are constructed. A shows charge states 6+ through 12+ for one 12,000 Da molecule. B uses only carbon-13 variation among 50 sites, vertically offset by charge. C compares two ions 0.01435 apart at different FWHM resolving powers, vertically offset.
